latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator Downfall: Easily remove or fix captions in your video clips, ready for fast reposting.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) and request caption removal or fixes.
- Fast cloud processing delivers clean 1080p MP4 exports — no install or manual editing needed.
- Handles both burned-in and auto-generated captions via a simple chat-based workflow.
- Anonymous users receive free credits and can process several videos without registration.
- Seamless session management and export; clear error messages for file size, type, or credit issues.
